sentences.text: 2. Learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is carrying on business in manufacture of Tapioca Starch and Sago from Cassava Tubers (Tapioca Roots) in the name of ''S.N.K. Starch Industries'' which is a Small Scale Sago Manufacturing Unit.

As it has been following the rules and regulations and other procedures contemplated to manufacture of Tapioca Starch and Sago from Cassava Tubers by using Presser Motor Pump, the large scale manufacturers who are all competitors against the Small Scale units like the petitioner has started spreading false propaganda that cleaning of Tapioca Starch Operating Centrifugal Motor Pumps give room for adulteration and application of non-permitted additives, hence such equipment, namely, Centrifugal Motor Pumps are to be banned.

3. The learned Counsel for the petitioner further submitted that in fact the method of purifying Tapioca Starch with the operation of Centrifugal Motor Pump was introduced 20 years back only by the present day large scale Sago Manufacturing Units which were once upon a time operated as Small and Medium Tapioca Sago Manufacturing Units.

When the petitioner has been using the pressure motor in the manufacturing process, he was issued with the present impugned notice dated 05.06.2018 by the Food Safety Officer, Thalaivasal Union, Salem District, asking him to remove the same and also to submit Form D1 and a copy thereof has also been sent to the 3rd respondent and
on receipt of the same, the petitioner has also submitted a detailed reply dated 11.6.2018 specifically informing that the pressure motor has not been presently used.

With regard to the second defect, it has been stated that Form D1 dated 09.06.2018 has already been sent to the Food Safety Officer,
Thalaivasal Union, Thalaivasal and a copy of the same has also sent to the 3rd respondent.
But the grievance of the petitioner is that through the above notice dated 05.06.2018, directing the petitioner not to use the Pressure Motor is wholly unjustifiable.
The reason is without using the Pressure Motor, the petitioner cannot be able to carry on the business of manufacturing Tapioca Starch and Sago from Cassava Tubers.
Hence the present Writ Petition.

4. Learned Additional Government Pleader who takes notice for the respondents referring to the Minutes of the Steering Committee of the Food Safety and Drug Administration Department dated 13.4.2018 submitted that Guideline No.8 clearly shows that the petitioner should not use the pressure motor in the manufacturing process.

5. Heard the submissions made on either side and I have also carefully perused the materials available on record.
6.

sentences.text: Therefore, the petitioner had not challenged the said Minutes of the Steering Committee of the Food Safety and Drug Administration Department dated 13.04.2018, especially Guideline 8.
But, without challenging the same, the petitioner has filed this Writ Petition seeking to quash the impugned notice dated 5.6.2018, which is not sustainable.
Therefore, this Court finds no error or infirmity in the impugned notice on the file of the 3rd respondent.

T.RAJA, J.
tsi 7.In the result, the Writ Petition fails and the same is accordingly dismissed.
No costs.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is also closed.
